handoff.salientSummary: Built the Online Booking backend: public /reservations/* API (Origin-only org, flags, holds, idempotent book, HMAC manage tokens, manage/ics/mine/requests, durable rate limits), operator large-party approve/decline, RESERVATIONS_PUBLIC_ENABLED kill switch, and the App Sites gate. Full tenant-api suite (92 files, 1654 tests) passes, and curl on US 3007 and KSA 3009 confirmed the flows.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: tenant-api: routes/reservations-public.ts (config, availability with ETag/dayVersion/now, calendar, holds, holds/current, holds/release, POST /reservations book with Idempotency-Key, requests, manage + manage/availability, modify, cancel, confirm, late/running-late, calendar.ics/ics, mine), lib/reservations-public-auth.ts (org gate, kill switch, in-memory + durable rsv_rate_counters limits, capability tokens), services rsv-public-engine, rsv-hold-service, rsv-public-booking-service, rsv-public-service, rsv-ics, rsv-request-service; operator POST approve/decline on both /reservations/:id/* and /requests/:id/* under /operator/reservations/book; staff overbook can take a hold; org-router routes /reservations* only by Origin via the new resolveOrganizationForPublicOrigin; RESERVATIONS_PUBLIC_ENABLED added to .env.schema/.env.example/bindings. App: resources+/sites.reservations.ts gate. Carried-over: scale.test.ts uses a median, birthday/anniversary added to RSV_TAG_SYSTEM_KEY_VALUES, `as never` cast removed.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: Docs were not updated (docs-worker owns them). The Sites page and the operator Requests tab UI are other features. The agent-browser checks VAL-ONLINE-057/058/059 were not run; their backend (approve/decline, channel recording) is covered by route tests.

discoveredIssues.description: commands.set_org_flag writes only the App D1/data.db. tenant-api caches the reservations context for 5 minutes, so a flag flip is not seen by tenant-api until the cache expires or POST /internal/reservations/context-changed {orgId} (Bearer INTERNAL_COMMAND_TOKEN, dev value in packages/cache/.env.schema) is called. Validators should call it after set_org_flag (VAL-ONLINE-027/043, VAL-CROSS-013).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Have scripts/set-org-flag.sh POST context-changed to localhost:3007/3009 after the write.

discoveredIssues.description: Contract choices: API status requested = DB pending_approval. Manage token header is X-Reservation-Token (also ?t= for the .ics only); holds use the same header. Book is POST /reservations with required Idempotency-Key. Aliases /manage/running-late, /manage/ics, and operator /requests/:id/approve|decline are also mounted. Public confirmation codes are 8 chars (Crockford) while operator-created ones are 6. The App gate returns 404 unless master AND online are on (per VAL-ONLINE-043), and notifyMe follows the waitlist flag since the per-location setting lives in the regional DB. org-router no longer routes /reservations* by customer JWT; Origin only.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Docs worker should record these in docs/reservations-contract.md.
